title: discard: request
description: Remove a worktree run's worktree, changing nothing in the theatre's working tree. It doesn't undo what the run changed in the repository's shared state. A request never names a path, a diff or a workspace.

run.description: The run, by id or unique prefix.

reason.description: Why, in the person's words, recorded in lineage. Absent: none was given.

rehearse.description: Change nothing: report the worktree that would be removed. Absent means false.
